items.exampleEn: Can you show me your ticket?
items.exampleZh: 你可以給我看你的票嗎？

items.exampleEn: I run in the park every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我每天早上在公園跑步。

items.exampleEn: Can you help me move this table?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我移動這張桌子嗎？

items.exampleEn: This point on the map is our school.
items.exampleZh: 地圖上這個點是我們學校。

items.sentenceEn: Turn left and run to the bus stop.

items.audioEn: Can you hear the music? The concert starts at eight.
items.audioZh: 你聽得到音樂嗎？音樂會八點開始。

items.sentenceEn: Please show me the point on the map.
items.sentenceZh: 請指給我看地圖上的那個點。

items.sentenceEn: We moved to Taipei two years ago.

items.stemEn: The movie ____ at nine. Don't be late.
items.stemZh: 電影九點開始，不要遲到。

items.passageEn: Today is a big day for our family. We are moving to a new home. My father starts the car at six. My little sister holds my hand. On the way, Dad shows us the new school on a map. We hear music on the radio and sing together.
items.passageZh: 今天對我們家是個大日子，我們要搬新家了。爸爸六點發動車子，妹妹抓著我的手。路上爸爸在地圖上指給我們看新學校。我們聽著廣播裡的音樂一起唱歌。

questions.questionZh: 爸爸在地圖上給他們看什麼？

referenceEn: Can you hear what I am saying?
rubricZh: 「聽得到」用 can hear（例如 Can you hear me?）
寫 Can you hear what I am saying? 也正確

items.promptZh: 我妹妹昨天開始學畫畫。
referenceEn: My sister started to learn drawing yesterday.
My sister started learning to draw yesterday.
rubricZh: start 後面可接 to＋原形或動名詞（例如 started to learn、started learning）
昨天的事用過去式（例如 started）；「妹妹」可寫，例如 sister、little sister 等
